headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs secured a 3-0 shutout victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, led by Seiya Suzuki's 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Abner Uribe, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. Colt Emerson has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation, while Davis Martin is out with a right middle finger blister. Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with an abdominal strain, and Trevor McDonald has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain.

The Baltimore Orioles have acquired Harold Rivas in a trade with the Boston Red Sox, while the Kansas City Royals have acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 3-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, handing the Cardinals their loss. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief, striking out 8 batters and allowing 4 hits.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Mason Montgomery earned the save.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
